# Ask Krishna

> A quiet static Bhagavad Gita reflection and reading app.

Live site: https://hiteshgoyal.me/ask-krishna/

Ask Krishna is a fully static web app (plain HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript). No backend, no build step, no accounts.

## Pages

- Home / reflection flow: `/` or `/index.html`
- Read the Bhagavad Gita: `/pages/read.html` (700 verses, one verse at a time)

## Data (MIT-licensed; see NOTICE.md)

- Verse structure and Sanskrit: `/data/verses.json` — array of 700 objects `{ "id": "chapter.verse", "chapter": N, "verse": N, "sanskrit": "..." }`
- English translations: `/data/translations/en.json` — map `{ "1.1": "...", ... }`
- Hindi translations: `/data/translations/hi.json` — same shape
- UI strings per language: `/assets/locales/<code>.json` (codes: en, hi, sa)

## License and attribution

- App code: MIT — see `/LICENSE`
- Dataset source and translation attributions: see `/NOTICE.md`

## Suggested use for agents

Fetch `/data/verses.json` for Sanskrit text and structure. Fetch `/data/translations/en.json` or `/data/translations/hi.json` for readable translations. Verse IDs use the format `chapter.verse` (e.g. `2.47`).
